note: What check 7 reads (plan.md 6.5, 8). Records are append-only: under an append-only root a committed file is never modified or deleted; a change is a new file v<N>_<name> with revision N, whose predecessor (v<N-1>_<name>, or <name> for N = 2) exists in the same folder. A JSONL log only grows: the committed content must be a prefix of the new content. A skill's version is a folder <id>@v<N>/ under meta_agent/skills/: a landed version is never edited, a change is the next version's folder.
mutable_names_note: index.json is generated; LINKS.md takes the card id the Meta-Agent writes back; MATERIAL.json is a queue card whose state moves queued -> registered -> distilled in place (git history keeps the trail; the record of a material is the source record F1 writes under knowledge/sources/).
